name: NJM4580 / JRC4580 / RC4580
type: Bipolar dual audio op-amp (TI RC4580 second source)
tagline: Japan's cheap standard audio op-amp, found in countless sound cards and DACs; Soomal: neutral, above the NE5532.

lineage.note: Earliest datasheet found is Ver.2003-03-13. The '4558-derived upgrade' story is community lore, not vendor-documented.
Datasheets dated 20250303 mark NJM4580D (DIP8) and NJM4580L (SIP8) NRND; no electrical change noted.
Pin- and function-compatible RC4580 (SLOS412, April 2003), die origin undocumented; die now also sold as NE5532/LM833/MC33078.

part_numbers.note: DIP8 standard grade; 20250303 datasheet says NRND (JP: 保守品). Mouser still lists it.
DIP8 D-rank (≤1.4 µVrms RIAA); usual Japanese DIY part, stocked by Akizuki, Marutsu, Keisei.
DMP8 D-rank; RS Japan lists NJM4580MD-TE2.
SOP8 JEDEC 150 mil (NJR 'EMP8'); RS Japan lists NJM4580E-TE1.
SIP8; named NRND in the 20250303 datasheet.
SIP8 D-rank; not named separately in the NRND note.
MSOP8 (VSP8, JEDEC MO-187-DA), no D-rank; RS UK lists NJM4580R-TE2.
Trade name from the 'JRC 4580' marking; not an orderable part number.
TI SOIC-8 (SLOS412); IDR listed in bond-wire PCN 20231114002.1.
TI automotive version; SLOS707A (December 2010, revised July 2012).

key_specs.condition: RIAA, RS 2.2 kΩ, 30 kHz LPF, ±15 V
AV 20 dB, 5 V, 2 kΩ, 1 kHz, ±15 V

key_specs.value: ±2 V to ±18 V; RC4580 page: ±2 to ±16 V (32 V)
0.3 mV typ, 3 mV max; Ios 5 nA typ (200 nA max)
NJM4580 PNP (models); RC4580 polarity disputed, no diodes
key_specs.source: NJR SPICE models; TI E2E thread

reputation.summary: Asia's default 'standard audio op-amp'. Soomal finds it in many sound cards, speakers and DACs: neutral and plain ('平白如水'), high-resolution but characterless, and better than the NE5532. Japanese hobbyists call it fast, smooth and easy to listen to. Others rank it below the NE5532 or call it average. Its ±2 V minimum suits USB-powered DIY.
typical_uses: Sound-card outputs and inputs (TerraTec, TempoTec, Musiland)
Active speakers, headphone amps and DACs (Musiland, TempoTec)
Japanese CD players and AV gear (ONKYO, DENON, PIONEER)
USB-powered DIY DACs and headphone amps (±2 V minimum)
caveats: Not high-end: nabe ranks it below the NE5532; 'better than NE5532' is Soomal's view alone.
Often confused with the far cheaper, pin-compatible JRC4558 (Soomal).
No current-noise spec; noise is only RIAA-weighted (RS 2.2 kΩ), with nV/√Hz shown as a graph.
DIP NJM4580D and SIP NJM4580L are NRND; future DIP rolling may need SMD-to-DIP adapters.
TI RC4580 is a different part (12 vs 15 MHz). Swings ±13.5 V into 2 kΩ; buffer low-impedance headphones.

counterfeit_notes: No documented fakes; the plausible risk is 4558s relabelled as 4580s (Soomal notes the confusion). Buy authorised; check logo, font and date codes; distrust cheap NOS DIP lots. Bench check: ~15 MHz GBW, ~5 V/µs slew; 4558-class parts are slower.
alternatives: µPC4570 (tighter bass than NJM4580DD, per C-Area)

silicon_changes.summary: TI moved NE5532, LM833 and MC33078 onto the RC4580 die (E2E thread; Rich Cabot via Hackaday: 'they just relabeled a 4580'). Headphonesty reports failures on ±22 V-class rails, removed input diodes and halved HBM ESD. RC4580 is the donor, so little changes for it; JRC NJM4580 is unaffected.
silicon_changes.identification: NE5532: SLOS075K (Dec 2025) is new silicon, SLOS075J (Jan 2015) legacy. RC4580: no marker; SLOS412E (Nov 2024) changes unknown. SFAB → RFAB, 2024–2025.

spec_deltas.after: removed (RC4580 die has none) - Headphonesty / E2E summary

silicon_changes.audio_impact: None documented for RC4580. Post-2024 TI NE5532, LM833 and MC33078 behave like RC4580-class parts: 5 V/µs, ±18 V max, no input diodes.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low for RC4580 (donor die); high for TI NE5532/LM833 users on ±18–22 V rails or needing input diodes.
silicon_changes.verification: E2E 1652528 title, Cabot quote and NE5532 22 → 18 V, 2 → 1 kV ESD confirmed; RC4580 re-fab unestablished.

silicon_changes.summary: TI E2E China ('RC4580: PCN change-Wire binding') reports PCN 20231114002.1 moves the RC4580 bond wire from gold to copper. The same PCN carries the NE5532DR/SA5532ADR/LM833DR/MC33078DR process migration. A customer asked about supply-current impact; TI's answer was not captured.
silicon_changes.identification: Lot or date code after the PCN first-ship date; wire material cannot be seen from outside.
silicon_changes.audio_impact: None expected; bond-wire material has negligible electrical effect at audio frequencies.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: assembly material change only; no datasheet change.
silicon_changes.verification: E2E China 1058498 ties the PCN to an RC4580 gold-to-copper wire change; full device list not seen.

silicon_changes.summary: Rev E came during the SFAB-to-RFAB move and die consolidation; its change list is unknown. RFAB PCNs 20240429005.1 (30 Apr 2024, die revision) and 20250129000.1 (3 Feb 2025, HPA8, 300 mm) exist, but RC4580 membership is unconfirmed. Datasheet says ±18 V; product page ±16 V.
silicon_changes.identification: Datasheet revision letter (SLOS412E). Headline specs look unchanged, so a bench test is unlikely to separate old from new.

spec_deltas.before: 'Operating voltage ±2 V to ±18 V' (datasheet feature bullet)

silicon_changes.audio_impact: Unknown: no measurements of pre- versus post-2024 RC4580 found.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: headline specs appear unchanged; check SLOS412E abs-max and ESD before relying on older margins.
silicon_changes.verification: Rev E date confirmed; its change list and the PCN 20240429005.1 device list not seen.

silicon_changes.vendor: Texas Instruments vs New JRC / Nisshinbo
silicon_changes.summary: TI's RC4580 is a pin- and function-compatible second source, not shown to be a JRC die. GBW is lower (12 vs 15 MHz); other headline figures match. NJM4580 input is PNP per NJR SPICE models; RC4580's is disputed (Headphonesty NPN, Cabot/diyAudio PNP). Its die now also ships as NE5532/LM833/MC33078.
silicon_changes.identification: Part number and logo: TI RC4580 (ID/IDR/IP/IPWR) versus JRC/NJR/Nisshinbo NJM4580, often called JRC4580 after its marking.
silicon_changes.audio_impact: No comparative listening test or measurement found; the reputation was earned by the JRC part.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: drop-in pinout and similar supply range; slightly lower GBW on the TI part.
silicon_changes.verification: SLOS412 'April 2003' origin seen; no separate check of the listed differences.

Which document carries the RC4580 '±2 V to ±16 V' / 'Dual, 32-V' wording?
Confirm NJM4580 and RC4580 input polarity from datasheet equivalent circuits; Headphonesty's PNP → NPN may be reversed.

When was the NJM4580 introduced, and did electrical specs change between the 2003, 2012 and 2025 editions?

claims_confirmed: TI E2E thread 'NE5532, LM833, RC4580 and MC33078 all now the same die' exists: https://e2e.ti.com/support/audio-group/audio/f/audio-forum/1652528/ne5532-ne5532-lm833-rc4580-and-mc33078-all-now-the-same-die
Classic NE5532 has back-to-back input diodes; the RC4580 does not: https://e2e.ti.com/support/audio-group/audio/f/audio-forum/1652528/ne5532-ne5532-lm833-rc4580-and-mc33078-all-now-the-same-die

Rich Cabot found the RC4580 die in the new NE5532; ±22 → ±18 V, HBM 2000 → 1000 V, diodes removed: https://hackaday.com/2026/06/03/texas-instruments-changes-the-ne5532-and-others-into-incompatible-versions/ and https://www.headphonesty.com/2026/07/industry-trusted-op-amp-rebuilt-boards-failing/
Current RC4580 datasheet is SLOS412E, April 2003, revised November 2024: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/rc4580.pdf and https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/slos412e/slos412e.pdf
Rev D copies titled '(Rev. D)': https://download.mikroe.com/documents/datasheets/RC4580%20Datasheet.pdf and https://www.mouser.com/ds/2/405/rc4580-405584.pdf

Rev C copies show 'SLOS412C - APRIL 2003 - REVISED MARCH 2004': https://datasheet.octopart.com/RC4580IPWR-Texas-Instruments-datasheet-153412.pdf and https://e2e.ti.com/cfs-file/__key/communityserver-discussions-components-files/6/1602.RC4580IDR.PDF

PCN 20240429005.1 (30 April 2024): RFAB qualification with die revision, datasheet and assembly options for select devices: https://mm.digikey.com/Volume0/opasdata/d220001/medias/docus/6166/PCN20240429005.1.pdf
PCN 20250129000.1 (3 February 2025): RFAB with die revision, HPA8 process on 300 mm wafers: https://mm.digikey.com/Volume0/opasdata/d220001/medias/docus/6537/PCN_20250129000_1.pdf

PCN 20231114002.1 concerns RC4580 bond-wire material, RC4580IDR listed: https://mm.digikey.com/Volume0/opasdata/d220001/medias/docus/5726/PCN20231114002.1.pdf and https://e2echina.ti.com/support/audio/f/audio-forum/1058498/rc4580-pcn-change-wire-binding/3816175
Nisshinbo English header 'NJM4580 - 1 - 20250303 NJM4580D / NJM4580L are the NRND products': https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/294/NJM4580_E-2998482.pdf
NJR English edition 'Ver.2012-09-14' hosted by Mouser: https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/294/njr_njm4580_e-551676.pdf
RC4580 feature bullets: ±2 to ±18 V, 0.8 µVrms, 12 MHz, 5 V/µs, 0.0005% THD: https://www.ti.com/lit/gpn/RC4580
TI RC4580 headline: Dual, 32-V, 12-MHz, 6.5 nV/√Hz; '±2 to ±16 V' wording: https://www.ti.com/product/RC4580

Nisshinbo NJM4580 product page exists; RS UK lists NJM4580R-TE2 (15 MHz, 2 to 18 V, MSOP8): https://www.nisshinbo-microdevices.co.jp/en/products/operational-amplifier/spec/?product=njm4580 and https://uk.rs-online.com/web/p/op-amps/2448616P
